description: This file defines the Localization class in the SuiteCRM project, providing methods for managing locale-specific data such as character sets, number and date formatting, and name display formats.

classes.name: Localization
classes.description: The Localization class provides functionality for managing locale-specific settings like charsets, number formats, date formats, and name formats in the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Localization object, loads currencies, and sets default locale name format.

methods.name: getLocaleConfigDefaults
methods.description: Returns the default locale configuration settings based on system and user preferences.

methods.name: getPrecedentPreference
methods.description: Retrieves the most relevant user or system preference for a given locale setting.

methods.name: loadCurrencies
methods.description: Loads available currencies from the database and cache.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Returns the list of currencies loaded in the system.

methods.name: getDefaultCurrencies
methods.description: Provides a list of default currencies with ISO codes, names, and symbols.

methods.name: translateStringPack
methods.description: Translates an array of language strings into the target charset.

methods.name: translateForEmail
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings to the charset used for email transmission.

methods.name: prepBeanForExport
methods.description: Prepares a data bean for export by translating its text fields into the export charset.

methods.name: translateCharset
methods.description: Converts a string from one charset to another, using mbstring or iconv.

methods.name: addBOM
methods.description: Prefixes a string with a BOM marker based on charset.

methods.name: translateCharsetMIME
methods.description: Encodes a string for MIME headers in the specified charset.

methods.name: normalizeCharset
methods.description: Normalizes charset names to lowercase and removes delimiters.

methods.name: getCharsetSelect
methods.description: Provides a list of available character sets with translatable labels.

methods.name: getExportCharset
methods.description: Gets the preferred charset for exports, considering user and system defaults.

methods.name: getOutboundEmailCharset
methods.description: Gets the charset used for outbound emails, considering user preferences.

methods.name: getDecimalSeparator
methods.description: Returns the decimal separator character based on user/system preference.

methods.name: getNumberGroupingSeparator
methods.description: Returns the thousands separator character for number formatting.

methods.name: getPrecision
methods.description: Returns the number of significant digits for currency display.

methods.name: getCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Returns the currency symbol based on user/system preference.

methods.name: getLocaleFormattedNumber
methods.description: Formats a number according to locale-specific conventions, including currency symbols.

methods.name: getNumberJs
methods.description: Provides JavaScript code to format numbers dynamically on the client side.

methods.name: getLocaleFormatMacro
methods.description: Returns the macro string representing the locale's name format.

methods.name: getLocaleFormattedName
methods.description: Formats a person's name according to locale-specific format.

methods.name: getNameJs
methods.description: Provides JavaScript for previewing name format in locale settings.

methods.name: isAllowedNameFormat
methods.description: Checks if a name format string contains only allowed characters.

methods.name: invalidLocaleNameFormatUpgrade
methods.description: Checks for a file indicating invalid locale name format upgrade issues.

methods.name: createInvalidLocaleNameFormatUpgradeNotice
methods.description: Creates a file indicating an invalid locale name format upgrade issue.

methods.name: removeInvalidLocaleNameFormatUpgradeNotice
methods.description: Removes the upgrade indicator file.

methods.name: getUsableLocaleNameOptions
methods.description: Filters locale name format options to include only valid and translatable formats.

methods.name: detectCharset
methods.description: Guesses the charset of a string based on available PHP functions.
